annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act (Senate Bill 720, Chapter 634)
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act (Senate Bill 720, Chapter 634)
annotation.summary_en: Maryland statute (Ch. 634, SB 720) requiring the State Department of Education to issue AI guidance for schools, local school systems to adopt AI policies and coordinators, use an evaluation rubric for AI tools, provide educator professional development, and creating a Maryland AI Education Collaborative. Effective June 1, 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Department must publish AI guidance for students, educators, administrators, and parents, reviewed annually
Each local school system must adopt an AI policy within 120 days of guidance release and designate an AI coordinator
Department develops rubric; local systems must use it to select AI tools and procure consistently with State procurement law
AI literacy to be added to workforce and computer science standards by June 1, 2027; teacher training by July 1, 2027
Creates Maryland AI Education Collaborative reporting annually from December 1, 2027; Section 2 abrogated after May 31, 2028
